name: Summer Fun "Watermelon" Cups with Strawberry & Lime Flavored Gelatin

instructions.primary_message: Make sure you have enough space in your fridge to accommodate a small baking sheet pan or tray. Arrange 8 small glasses or plastic cups on a baking sheet or tray.
Place hot water (from the tap) in a small saucepan or kettle and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat.

Place lime gelatin in a medium bowl. Add the boiling water and whisk until all the gelatin is dissolved, 30-60 seconds. Add cold water (from the tap) and stir to combine. Divide lime gelatin between the glasses (about a ⅓-cup each), then place the baking sheet in the fridge until the gelatin is fully set, about 4 hours. (Reserve pan for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (85 g) pkg gelatin dessert mix, lime-flavored
1 cup water

instructions.primary_message: When the lime gelatin is completely set, place more hot water (from the tap) in the reserved saucepan or kettle and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat.
Place strawberry gelatin in a clean medium bowl. Add the boiling water and whisk until all the gelatin is dissolved, 30-60 seconds. Set bowl aside to cool slightly, 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (85 g) pkg gelatin dessert mix, strawberry flavored

instructions.primary_message: When the strawberry gelatin is cool, add yogurt and milk to the bowl, then gently whisk to combine (taking care not to over-whisk and create too many air bubbles).
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups vanilla Greek yogurt
¾ cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Add creamy strawberry gelatin to the glasses, creating the second layer of color. (PRO TIP: Tilt the glasses and add the strawberry gelatin at an angle, pouring gently, to prevent it from mixing with the previous layer.) Return glasses to the fridge until fully set, about 4 hours.
When the gelatin cups are fully set, remove from the fridge, sprinkle with chocolate chips (to create the "seeds"), and enjoy!
